title: Thanksgiving Fun & Learning
description: Celebrate Thanksgiving with eight warm autumn activities for preschool and kindergarten: share what you are thankful for, build a turkey, color by number, trace Thanksgiving words, count pictures, finish feather patterns, order pumpkin growth, and search a busy autumn scene.
learningFocus: Say and write what they are thankful for, in words or drawings.
Cut out pieces and build a turkey by following a model.
Recognize numbers 1 to 5 and match each number to a color.
Form lowercase letters on primary handwriting guidelines and match words to pictures.
Count objects by kind in a grid and write each total.
Finish AB, AAB, and ABC repeating patterns.
Put four pumpkin-growing stages in order.
Search a busy scene and count each kind of object.
adultGuidance: Encourage your child to talk about their answers before writing or drawing. Help with cutting and gluing on Page 2, and use crayons or colored pencils for the coloring and pattern activities. For older children, extend the learning by asking them to write sentences, explain patterns, or solve simple counting problems. Celebrate their effort and creativity!
